text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Jordan's King Hussein congratulates Kuwait on its National Day and welcomes Kuwait's release of 10 Jordanians convivted of undermining state security. Some 405 prisoners were released in celebration of Kuwait's 1961 independence from Britain and the sixth anniversary of the end of the Gulf War.
- Parliament expected to increase Interior Ministry bonuses.

- Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti said some elements in Jordan and Kuwait were blocking the resumption of ties. Kuwait, which has accused Jordan of siding with Iraq during its 1990-91 occpuation of the Gulf Arab state, has turned down several overtures by Amman to normalise relations.
- Kuwait Coast Guard detain an armed Iraqi boat which entered its territorial waters on Monday.
- Kuwait's Chamber of Commerce and Industry says no cooperation with Iraq as long as President Saddam Hussein remained in power.
